author: parlay-locks
notes: Panel ran (3/3 ok; Claude 9-0, Cursor 9-0, Codex 8-1). Veto only per P3: dropped L6 (Dort O2.5 reb) because Codex named a THIN/RISK gap (18-20 min in 3 of his last 4, which the reasoning doesn't address). The other 8 legs had no named error and stay eligible; vote counts weren't used to rank. 11am recheck: Turner, Huerter, Bratt and Cooley not on injury reports (Huerter projected to start). Suggs is listed day-to-day (knee, returning; played 25 min on 11/16), so he's kept only in the UD 3-Flex, where a DNP voids. Amen Thompson (HOU) is questionable, which would only push more creation to Sengun. Every leg is P1-priced (per-book devig median, 4-6 books, stamped 9:47 AM ET). All overs, so there's no under shading. One leg per game, 8 games. 5-leg avg est 0.594 > 0.566, so PrizePicks 5-pick Power (20x) per P4. The 3-leg is UD 3-pick Flex (3.25x/1.09x), the 2-leg is UD Standard with overs only, and the 2- and 3-leg share no legs. App lines are unconfirmed, so drop any leg whose app line differs or is a Goblin/Demon.

slips.rationale: Overs only (P4): Jalen Smith O1.5 ast (60.4%, 3,3,3,2 last 4 with CHI frontcourt out) + Bratt O1.5 SOG (59.9%, PP1 vs a thin MTL D). Different sports and games. Est joint 36.2% vs 28.6% BE.

UD 3-Flex (3.25x for 3/3, 1.09x for 2/3) on the three legs outside the 5-leg: Sengun O6.5 ast, Suggs O3.5 ast, Gordon O1.5 ast. Independent of the 2-leg. Each leg clears the 55.4% BE (56.3-59.6%), and Flex cushions one miss.

Five highest-priced overs, five different games: Turner O1.5 ast, J. Smith O1.5 ast, Bratt O1.5 SOG, Cooley O1.5 SOG, Huerter O2.5 ast. Avg est 59.4% > 56.6%, so Power (20x) per P4. Shares 2 legs with the 2-leg but none with the 3-leg, so the top two aren't nested across all three.
